Card: Container card for content sections. Use for forms/content boxes, NOT for page headers.
Tabs: Tab navigation. Use { $bindState } on value for active tab binding.
Accordion: Collapsible sections. Items as [{title, content}]. Type 'single' (default) or 'multiple'.
Collapsible: Collapsible section with trigger. Children render inside.
Dialog: Modal dialog. Set openPath to a boolean state path. Use setState to toggle.
Drawer: Bottom sheet drawer. Set openPath to a boolean state path. Use setState to toggle.
Table: Data table. columns: header labels. rows: 2D array of cell strings, e.g. [["Alice","admin"],["Bob","user"]].
Heading: Heading text (h1-h4)
Image: Image component. Renders an img tag when src is provided, otherwise a placeholder.
Tooltip: Hover tooltip. Shows content on hover over text.
Popover: Popover that appears on click of trigger.
Input: Text input field. Use { $bindState } on value for two-way binding. Use checks for validation (e.g. required, email, minLength). validateOn controls timing (default: blur).
Textarea: Multi-line text input. Use { $bindState } on value for binding. Use checks for validation. validateOn controls timing (default: blur).
Select: Dropdown select input. Use { $bindState } on value for binding. Use checks for validation. validateOn controls timing (default: change).
Checkbox: Checkbox input. Use { $bindState } on checked for binding. Use checks for validation. validateOn controls timing (default: change).
Radio: Radio button group. Use { $bindState } on value for binding. Use checks for validation. validateOn controls timing (default: change).
Switch: Toggle switch. Use { $bindState } on checked for binding. Use checks for validation. validateOn controls timing (default: change).
Slider: Range slider input. Use { $bindState } on value for binding.
Button: Clickable button. Bind on.press for handler.
Link: Anchor link. Bind on.press for click handler.
DropdownMenu: Dropdown menu with trigger button and selectable items. Use { $bindState } on value for selected item binding.
Toggle: Toggle button. Use { $bindState } on pressed for state binding.
ToggleGroup: Group of toggle buttons. Type 'single' (default) or 'multiple'. Use { $bindState } on value.
ButtonGroup: Segmented button group. Use { $bindState } on selected for selected value.
Pagination: Page navigation. Use { $bindState } on page for current page number.
